episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Joseon stands firm against U.S. incursion. Yoo Jin survives in America as Eugene. Ae Shin knows that great change is afoot with global ramifications.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The empress has been murdered: For Ae Shin, words are useless against rapacious foreign powers; she'll take up arms instead. Eugene gets a new post.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: In an age of imported coffee and fashions, Ae Shin prefers her German gun, but wonders what the English word ''love'' means and whether Eugene is a friend.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Suspicions run deep as U.S. troops lose a gun on a train. Ae Shin shows Dong Mae compassion, Hee Sung returns to Joseon, and Eugene considers revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Ae Shin meets Hee Sung for coffee at the hotel. Eugene deals with Japanese troops at the U.S. legation, and wants to know why Ae Shin defends Joseon.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Ae Shin gets a new mission. Eugene, Dong Mae and Hee Sung have something in common. Eugene delves into his past, and finally gives Ae Shin his answer.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Ae Shin learns love's real meaning and crushes a thug. Emperor Gojong asserts Joseon's authority. Eugene reveals his Korean name to Ae Shin.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Despite being advised to lay low as a noble lady, Ae Shin undertakes a dangerous operation. Eugene makes a surprising move and Hee Sung probes his past.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Eugene wants to know why Ae Shin can't pull back, but her path is with the Righteous Army. Hee Sung disagrees with Ae Shin and offers an alternative.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: The emperor seeks Eugene's aid. Hee Sung visits the tailor. Ae Shin feels conflicted after hearing Eugene's story, but later sees him on a snowy night.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Ae Shin apologizes to Eugene, but he hopes that she'll keep fighting for her Joseon. Hee Sung takes a streetcar ride with Ae Shin and proposes a plan.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Reaffirming her commitment, Ae Shin stands by her decision. While she makes an unexpected pact over castella cake, Eugene investigates an old photograph.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Ae Shin and Eugene take a ride out to the sea. A nefarious scoundrel takes great interest in Hee Sung and Eugene. Lord Go Sa Hong meets with Hee Sung.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Eugene gets devastating news, Dong Mae is apprehended, Ae Shin asks Hina for help and Hee Sung comes to the rescue when Eugene finds himself cornered.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: A disquieting sight vexes Emperor Gojong. Ae Shin defies Lord Go, Eugene refuses to forgive, and Hee Sung visits the Go Family estate.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Hee Sung starts a newspaper and makes a personal sacrifice. Lord Go marshals support, Ae Shin imagines a different life, and Eugene goes to the palace.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.summary: After giving up that which means the most to him, Hee Sung gets a friend a gift. Lord Go leads an urgent appeal, and Ae Shin faces Japanese troops.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.summary: Eugene contends with a viperous imperialist. Seeing Lord Go's incarceration, Hee Sung publishes a special edition. Ae Shin snubs a Japanese official.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.summary: Lady Ae Shin loses a part of herself. Lord Go counters mounting imperialist schemes, Hee sung avenges Ae Shin and Emperor Gojong strikes down a snake.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.summary: The righteous army retaliates against Japanese troops and Ae Shin seeks justice. War breaks out in Joseon - and Eugene gets orders to return to the U.S.

episodes.title: Episode 21
episodes.summary: Called an American imperialist, Eugene later asks Ae Shin why she persists in a futile cause. Hee Sung helps Ae Shin out of a bind. An ally joins Ae Shin.

episodes.title: Episode 22
episodes.summary: Emperor Gojong tries to shield the nation but is thrust into an impasse. Finding herself behind the eight ball, Ae Shin concedes that words have power.

episodes.title: Episode 23
episodes.summary: Seeing the explosion, Hee Sung, Dong Mae and Eugene fear the worst. The world's indifference dismays Emperor Gojong, but Joseon's defiance gets bolder.

episodes.title: Episode 24
episodes.summary: Joseon remains steadfast. The Righteous Army perseveres on its course. Ae Shin keeps her flame ablaze, while Hee Sung, Dong Mae and Eugene try to help.
